fact: Chapter 6 is titled 'The Place Of Inspiration', and the highest order of mental excellence is accessible by inspiration
Inspiration is the master key to supernatural intelligence
Inspiration is your connection to supernatural mental empowerment, empowering you to perform supernatural feats by granting you insight into supernatural depths
Without inspiration there is no genius, as ingenuity is a direct product of inspiration
Job 32:8 is the chapter's key text: 'But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding'
Joseph knew how to preserve food for fourteen years without the use of chemicals, cited as Genesis 41:48-49,53-54,56
Isaac knew how to get bountiful harvest without rain through inspiration, cited as Genesis 26:1-12
Inspiration helped Jacob to rear the colour of cattle he desired, without a university degree in veterinary medicine or a research institute, cited as Genesis 30:37-43
Jacob's cattle was not a trial and error experiment; he knew what he was doing and what the outcome would be, which was supernatural insight
Jesus was to feed 5,000 people in a barren desert place, and John 6:6 says 'He himself knew what he would do'
Inspiration, NOT mental exertion, is the master-key to a world of supernatural intelligence, and it is your vital link with divine wisdom
1 Corinthians 2:11 is quoted: 'For what man knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God'
The author's own definition: inspiration is the Spirit of God in motion in the mental faculty of a man, the movement of the Holy Spirit in a man's mental faculties
At creation, as the Spirit of God moved upon the deep, the wisdom of God came on the scene to accomplish the work of creation
Inspiration is summarised as 'spirit in motion', and it is a supernatural energizing of your mental faculty
God's wisdom is packaged in the Bible, which was delivered to man via the channel of inspiration, not intellectualism
2 Timothy 3:16 is quoted: 'All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness'
In Luke 11:49 Jesus said 'Therefore also said the wisdom of God...', referring to the Bible
The author DISAGREES completely with philosophers who claim that a genius is made from 99 per cent perspiration and 1 per cent inspiration
Every true discovery came by an inner movement, and without that 1 per cent the 99 per cent will be equal to zero
Inspiration is the covenant catalyst that makes the reaction take place at all: if that 1 per cent is not there there is no reaction, and if there is no reaction everything else is zero
The author has made discoveries in the Christian faith that were not from any book, and has propounded theories you will not find in any book except the ones he wrote
Those theories are inventions, but because they are not scientific inventions they do not have physical products; they have human products, men and women who authenticate them
You must camp with God and live within the sphere of inspiration so you can flow in supernatural intelligence
Inspiration has nothing to do with a man's age
Elihu is the speaker of Job 32:7-9, who said 'Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom' and then 'Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment'
The declaration to make is 'Spirit of God, begin to move inside me now. Move me out of every mental blockage, into the realms of mental enlargement'
Isaiah 55:8 is cited that God's ways are higher than your ways, so it takes the movement of the Spirit of God in your mental faculty to connect with this higher level of wisdom
When you do things under inspiration the world calls you a fantastic man, but the author says he is not fantastic, he only has a fantastic Spirit moving on his inside
Such a man is an ordinary man like anybody else, but has the movement of a fantastic Spirit in his mental region, enabling him to generate fantastic, enviable and humbling results
Smith Wigglesworth is quoted as saying 'If the Spirit does not move me, I'll move the Spirit'
The two ways given to generate inspiration are SINGING and MEDITATION
When you sing, what you are doing is working up the Spirit of God inside you, so to receive inspiration for the day you start singing as soon as you wake up in the morning
Prophet Elisha used singing when he was in dire need of divine inspiration to handle a pressing national issue brought to him
2 Kings 3:15 is quoted: 'But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the LORD came upon him'
The hand of the Lord came upon Elisha as the minstrel began to play and brought Elisha into a supernatural depth of insight
Psalm 22:3 is cited that God inhabits the praises of His people, so you can sing the Spirit of God into manifestation
Meditation means engaging a mental focus on an issue, for the purpose of enlightenment and illumination
2 Corinthians 3:18 is quoted: 'But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord'
As you engage in a mental focus on the Word of God you are changed, and the Spirit of God inside you is stirred into action
There is no substitute for inspiration, and your mental faculty will remain dormant without that breath of the Almighty from on high
Inspiration is the principal asset of every genius
There are people who read and read yet nothing seems to be turning on inside them, everything still looks dark, and they remain people of average intelligence
Only the inspiration of the Almighty gives understanding, and you cannot separate surpassing intelligence from inspiration
There has to be a drawing from heaven before you can become outstanding in the school of intelligence
The enemies of inspiration are fear, anxiety and concerns
The enemies of inspiration weigh down your spirit, causing it to choke under their weight, and they paralyze your mental abilities
The devil knows he cannot handle you when you are inspired, so he generates concerns, anxieties and burdens to keep you too busy to open up to God's inspiration
All the demands for enjoying inspiration require grace: grace to meditate effectively, grace to be studious, and grace to worship God into the realms of inspiration
